note: Bets EVERY totals grade A+ offer to verify the grade on 2026 lines. Basis: output/research/grade_granular.md Q2 (frozen model grade_totals_model.json): 2023-25 one-shot holdout A+ CLV +1.48% +- 0.66 (p 0.012), 243 bets (~81/season), ROI +7.5% +- 6.1; dev 2020-22 +2.26% +- 0.61 on 218. Post-hoc ~95% of A+ bets were early-week unders (median 139 h before kick). 2023-25 was also the holdout of earlier studies, so the 2026 season is the clean test. Overlaps the early-week under track by design (separate ledger and record). Do not edit to fit results; bump version instead.
grade: grade_totals.py (GRADING_VERSION 2): A+ = predicted CLV >= 0.0% of the allowed-book over/under quote with the highest predicted CLV (game['totals_grade']); graded only 10 min .. 7 days before kickoff

qualify.window_note: research: graded within 7 days of kickoff (first snapshot <= 7 days)
qualify.lock: One bet per game at the FIRST snapshot where the game's best offer is A+, at that offer's book and price; later snapshots never change it. Snapshots = every full run (pipeline update) AND every hourly odds watch (pipeline watch). The research looked only at our historical run times (sparser), so more looks can only find more A+ moments: expect somewhat more bets than the research rate and judge the result on 2026 lines.
qualify.bet: the graded side (over or under) at the book, number and price that were graded A+

validation.clv_definition: totals.grade: EV of our side at our point and price under the fair expected total of our own last pre-kickoff odds snapshot (closing_totals, all-book median, prices included); clv_sharp_close recorded for information
